name: Rhythm Reunion
source:
The band is getting back together! Haven't you heard?! 'Summer Vacation' is reuniting for one last gig! I heard a rumour that they're playing this weekend, down at the local club. We just HAVE to go and see them!

The only trouble is none of the members want anything to do with each other anymore... Without anyone to play the club will never attract any customers...

It's up to you to rekindle old passions and reunite lost rhythms!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2813750/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
乐队又要重聚了！你没听说过吗？！《暑假》最后一场演出即将重聚！我听说有传言说他们这个周末要在当地俱乐部比赛。我们必须去看看他们！

唯一的麻烦是，没有一个会员愿意再与彼此有任何关系……没有人玩，俱乐部永远不会吸引任何顾客……

重燃旧日激情并重新找回失去的节奏就靠你了！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2813750/]Steam[/url]]
